notes: Implicit trigger-calibration prompts for issue #21, measured against the SKILL.md description released in v1.8.0. Each prompt has a category. positive prompts should activate the skill; adjacent prompts sit next to its scope (web, GUI, editor or font configuration, shell work with no interface) and should not; clear negatives are unrelated; ambiguous prompts have no expected outcome and are reported as rates only. P01-P12 and N01-N12 repeat the historical 2026-07-10 set in trigger-evals.json so the two can be read side by side. Run with scripts/runners/trigger_probe.py through each host's implicit-invocation path, never by naming the skill in the prompt.
